pairs.subject: interview-calendar-integrity
pairs.evidence: app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:368 The confirm path re-checks the calendar on three values and lets an unknown through without blocking, as required. But when slotStillFree returns null the booking goes ahead with nothing recorded on the invite, so the recruiter cannot tell an unverified booking from a verified-free one. A search for unverified/calendar_check/calendarVerified across schedule-store, core.ts, app/api/schedule and app/_lib/calendar found no such field.

techniques.evidence: app/api/schedule/route.ts:85 The recruiter wire carries the full status (checked / not_connected / unavailable / needs_reconnect from available-slots.ts). An unknown status degrades to the unfiltered pre-integration list.

app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:368 Each writer (candidate confirm, grid book, reschedule, accept_proposal) re-checks the calendar, only a definite busy refuses, and an unknown proceeds. The miss: the technique says to record the branch on the booking and show it to the recruiter, and a null result leaves no trace.

app/api/schedule/calendar-conflict.test.ts:132 Every proposeFreeSlots and slotStillFree call is passed invite.durationMin, and the test pins it. The store refuses an overlap or a same-hour clash inside the .immediate() transaction (comment at route.ts:219).

app/api/schedule/calendar-writeback.test.ts:282 A reschedule patches the same event and cancel/withdraw delete it. A failed delete becomes 'orphaned' with the handle kept, a failed write never blocks the booking, and the five write states live on their own axis.
app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:181 The public token wire carries one bit only. calendarStatus and droppedForConflict go out only on the workspace-authenticated recruiter route (route.ts:85-86).

pairs.subject: interview-calendar-integrity
pairs.evidence: app/schedule/[token]/SlotPicker.tsx:112 The candidate sees one bit derived from the server's status, nothing about why it failed and no busy count. A refused confirm lands back on a refreshed list of current slots rather than a dead end.

techniques.evidence: app/schedule/[token]/SlotPicker.tsx:112 There are only two copies. The unchecked one ('aren't confirmed against the interviewer's calendar') names no cause and no count.
app/schedule/[token]/use-schedule-invite.ts:107 The bit is derived, not stored. A missing or false value falls to the cautious copy, so the page claims a check only when the server said checked.
app/schedule/[token]/use-schedule-invite.ts:189 The client half: a busy refusal re-fetches and shows the current slots beside the error banner (SchedulePicker keeps the picker mounted).
